entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Did we make it?

entries.speaker: Navigation Voice
entries.en: You have returned to the real world.[n]Welcome back.

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Huh? Returned?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Does that mean we got away?
Probably.
I wonder...

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: I dunno what to think anymore...

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: What was all that anyways? That castle,[n]and Kamoshida, and that weird cat!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: The hell's goin' on!?

entries.speaker: Aggressive Officer
entries.en: What's with the yelling? Are you students[n]of Shujin?

entries.speaker: Aggressive Officer
entries.en: Cutting classes, are we?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Huh? No!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: We were tryin' to get to school, and we[n]ended up at this weird castle!

entries.speaker: Aggressive Officer
entries.en: ...What?

entries.speaker: Aggressive Officer
entries.en: Hand over your bag. You better not be[n]doing any drugs.

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Why would you think that!?

entries.speaker: Timid Officer
entries.en: Are you his friend?
Something like that.
Never met him.
He was bullying me.

entries.speaker: Timid Officer
entries.en: Then you should go to school. Take him[n]with you.

entries.speaker: Timid Officer
entries.en: Oh... You seemed quite friendly with him[n]though. Anyway, you should go to school.

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Don't lie like that! Tell 'em what[n]happened!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Like I'm tryin' to say... I don't know what's[n]goin' on either!

entries.speaker: Aggressive Officer
entries.en: We passed by Shujin on our way here.[n]There was nothing out of the ordinary[n]about it.

entries.speaker: Aggressive Officer
entries.en: If you spout any more nonsense,[n]I'll contact your school. Is that what[n]you want?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: C'mon, say somethin'!
Let's get going.
I don't want to be late.

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Uh, that's not what I meant...

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: W-Wait a sec! Is that guy for real?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: ...Fine, I'm goin'!
